metadata.description: Fork of JordanCoin/codingskills split into separately enabled plugins, so each project turns on only the principles it wants

plugins.name: coding-base
plugins.description: Everyday code-quality principles: KISS, DRY, YAGNI, Boy Scout Rule and Convention over Configuration.

plugins.name: coding-arch
plugins.description: Structure and coupling principles: Separation of Concerns and Law of Demeter.

plugins.name: coding-solid
plugins.description: SOLID principles for codebases built around interfaces and class hierarchies.

plugins.name: coding-detect
plugins.description: Stack detection that writes .agents/stack-context.md, for projects without a CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md.
